name: Woo Installments – Pay in Parts for WooCommerce
author: Fahad Mahmood

sections.description:
Let customers buy anything in parts. Choose a usage type, define plans, and you are live.

Free
* Deposit + equal installments, or equal installments with no deposit
* Unlimited plans (every N days, weeks or months)
* Enable per product or for the whole shop, with a minimum price
* Payment schedule on thank-you page, emails, order screen and My Account > Installments
* Each installment is a real WooCommerce order with a pay link, so every gateway works
* Fulfil after the first payment or only when fully paid (“Partially paid” status)
* Settings tabs adapt to the usage type you choose
* Schedule preview in cart and checkout
* Admin can mark an installment paid (cash or bank transfer)
* Variable product support
* Shortcode [woo_installments] to show a customer’s schedules on any page
* WooCommerce Blocks cart/checkout and HPOS compatible

Pro (all code lives in the pro/ folder, unlocked by a license key)
* Custom percentage schedules, e.g. 30,20,20,30
* Email reminders before due date and when overdue
* Late fees with grace period
* Early payoff with optional discount
* Reports: open plans, outstanding and overdue balances, CSV export, dashboard widget
* Interest or service fee per plan
* Plan rules by user role and product category
* Customer extension requests with admin approval
* Default handling: hold or cancel (and restock) after N overdue installments
* SMS / WhatsApp reminders through a webhook
* Receipts per installment
* Optional auto-charge scheduler for gateway adapters (hook woo_inst_autocharge)
* Reservation preset: a deposit plan with one later installment
* License and update client (set woo_inst_license_server and woo_inst_update_url)

Note: tax and shipping are collected with the first payment.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce, then this plugin.
  2. Go to WooCommerce > Installments, pick a usage type and create plans.
  3. Edit a product, tick Installments in the General tab (or enable for all products).
sections.changelog:
2.1.0

  • New: cart and checkout schedule preview, admin mark-as-paid, variable products, [woo_installments] shortcode.
  • New (pro): plan fees, role and category rules, extension requests, default handling, SMS/WhatsApp webhook, receipts, CSV export, dashboard widget, auto-charge scheduler.
  • New: license and update client, translation template (.pot), WooCommerce Blocks compatibility flag, unit tests (php tests/run.php).

2.0.0

  • Rebuilt from a course-selling tool into a generic pay-in-parts plugin for any product.
  • New title and description.
  • New config-driven settings: tabs and fields appear per usage type.
  • New plan engine, installment child orders with pay links, “Partially paid” status.
  • New My Account > Installments page and schedule in emails.
  • New pro/ folder: custom schedules, reminders, late fees, early payoff, reports.
  • Tested up to WordPress 7.1; requires PHP 7.4, WooCommerce 7.0+; HPOS compatible.
  • Removed course packages, playlists, ghost products and bundled Bootstrap/FontAwesome.
  • Old v1 settings are preserved in the woo_inst_legacy_v1 option but not used.

1.4.0

  • Last release of the course-selling version.

short_description: Sell any WooCommerce product with a deposit and installments. Customers pay each part manually through a secure pay link, using any payment gateway.
